_comment: Dependency license policy for everything that SHIPS in the plugin bundle.
The policy itself is argued in CLAUDE.md 'Dependency Licensing' and in
docs/SECURITY.md. This file is what enforces it: build/licensecheck reads
it against the SBOMs make sbom writes, and make license-check fails the
Build-only dependencies are not judged here. The Go side is narrowed to
what go list -deps says is linked into the server binary, and the npm side
is generated with --omit dev, so the eslint, webpack, babel and playwright
toolchain never reaches this file. Copyleft there is fine and deliberate.
Every exception carries a reason, the same convention .grype.yaml uses for
vulnerability suppressions. An exception names one component AND one
license: a module that relicenses to something worse fails rather than
staying quietly excused, and an exception that stops matching anything is
itself an error, so this list cannot rot into modules that left years ago.

exceptions.reason: The RPC transport every Mattermost plugin uses, reached through mattermost/server/public. There is no plugin without it, so this one is not a choice. MPL 3.3 permits distributing covered files inside a proprietary Larger Work; the obligation is the notice and source availability for HashiCorp's own files, not for ours.
go-plugin's stream multiplexer, pulled in with it. Same terms and the same argument.
Transitive under go-multierror. Same terms and the same argument.
Transitive under mattermost/server/public. Same terms and the same argument.

The one MPL module that is ours rather than inherited: a direct require, used in exactly one place, expirable.LRU in server/preferences_cache.go. Roughly forty lines of stdlib would replace it and retire this entry. Recorded here so that stays visible rather than being rediscovered.

MIT, but its LICENSE file sits below cyclonedx-gomod's 0.85 detection confidence, so the SBOM carries no license for it and the unstated-means-forbidden rule catches it. Verified by reading github.com/tinylib/msgp's LICENSE in the module cache. Re-check on upgrade.

_noticeComment: Components whose upstream package ships no LICENSE, COPYING or NOTICE file.
build/notices refuses to write a notices file that silently omits a
component, so each one needs its text recorded here by hand.
Everything in a 'text' block below is either quoted from the package's own
metadata or is a statement about what the package does and does not
contain. No copyright line is invented: where upstream publishes none, the
entry says so and points at where the text is published instead.
